response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer, but the role requires native-level Japanese proficiency, strong C for UNIX development, Linux kernel source modification experience, and embedded networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced in the resume. His background centers on TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms, with only brief C/C++ exposure a decade ago, making the fit for this embedded LAN-switch security position very weak.
strengths: Long, varied software engineering career (15+ years) with senior/staff titles
Some low-latency systems work (async I/O, fibers, high-throughput services at Dunnhumby)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions and community teaching
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency listed (native-level Japanese is a hard requirement)
No Linux kernel, embedded firmware, or networking security experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, switch chips)
C experience is minimal and dated (~6 months at National Instruments in 2014–2015); career is web-focused

key_factors.factor: General seniority and systems programming exposure
